facts.fact: Ila took a small brown jar of goat fat from Dhanu's upper hut shelf on the second morning, corked and bound with a thong, and used it to dress Kunal's blistered hands.
facts.why: needed because the outline has her dress his hands with goat fat; the hut inventory (F515) did not list it.

facts.fact: At twelve Kunal saw no cairn-light at the Eye's cleft; only the bound can see it.
facts.why: needed to support the beat that the mountain marks the cleft.

facts.fact: Under the ice lip inside the Eye's cleft mouth is a meltwater hollow; Ila's dropped survey spike falls a count of three before it lands.
facts.why: needed because the ice lip must collapse.

facts.fact: Kunal's fingertips, blistered from the frostnip, burst open on the rope while holding Ila; dressed with strips of Ila's shirt hem.
facts.why: needed for the beat of him holding her with blistered hands.
